title: Tired of authors using ChatGPT in their books

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: "Did you know some bestselling authors are using ChatGPT to write their books?"

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: "This trend is blowing up on Reddit’s r/ChatGPT with 4,282 points and 396 comments."

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: "ChatGPT is being used to generate entire chapters and dialogue in novels."

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: "The AI can mimic specific authors’ styles with just a few sample paragraphs."

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: "Readers are upset because they’re paying for work that wasn’t actually written by humans."

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: "Authors using AI risk losing credibility and facing backlash from fans and critics."

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: "Want to know how to spot AI-generated writing in your next favorite book?"
